title: Tooling: 4.75× faster production P112 free-sink audit via signed modular determinants with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, production `research/p112-free-sink-audit97/independent.py` still computed every signed minor with rational `Fraction` elimination. woklerx’s opt-in adapter `research/p112-signed-modular86/` (incorporated [#1144](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1144)) already proved a modulo-521 kernel that recovers each full signed determinant inside a checked Hadamard envelope, with identical complete audit receipts. This PR wires that equivalent rewrite into the **production** independent checker.

The original rational elimination is retained as `rational_determinant` and as the fallback for rows outside the envelope. Pairwise Fraction-only bytes are vendored in `baseline.py`. The opt-in package vendors the same baseline for its reference engine. Leave-alone tooling through [#2431](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2431) and deferred `ck-dyadic-replay-production` / `scalar-fused-dyadic-production` were not reopened.

No certificate κ pins change.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 with `taskset -c 0`, five alternating in-process pairs over the complete 28,560-case / 4,030-minor audit gave median wall time **0.681 → 0.143 s (4.754×)** with per-round ratios **4.618–4.880×**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every audit receipt matches the pairwise baseline.

Package: `research/p112-signed-modular-production/`.
Tip: `d688ec0ff64f300c3ff124a60893c5c8c5e4f1c4`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p112-signed-modular-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/p112-signed-modular-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-signed-modular-production
python3.12 -B -m unittest tests.test_p112_signed_modular_production
taskset -c 0 python3.12 -I -B research/p112-signed-modular-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P112_SIGNED_MODULAR_PRODUCTION cases=28560 minors=4030 signed_matrices=19767 controls=10 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p112-signed-modular-production outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_P112_SIGNED_MODULAR_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Temp-copy certificate determinant-flip foil rejects via audit failure. Package gates under `-O` still load checkers with `compile(..., optimize=0)`. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Why the modular path is equivalent

Every frozen square minor has dimension at most eight and integer rows of squared Euclidean norm at most four. Hadamard’s inequality gives `|det A| ≤ 2^n ≤ 256`. Modulus 521 is prime and greater than twice 256, so the unique representative in `(-260, 260)` recovers the exact signed determinant whenever the modular path fires. See `research/p112-signed-modular86/`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): woklerx’s `research/p112-signed-modular86/` / [#1144](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1144) (opt-in modular dets; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756). Leave-alone tooling through [#2431](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2431) was not reopened. No competing open PR on production `p112-free-sink-audit97/independent.py` at refresh.
